    The two cases of the separation theorem #

    Case 1 (preprojComp_transport): a preprojective component over the quotient for Bᵢ(x) none of whose members restricts to Rᵢ(x) restricts to a preprojective component of A.

    Case 2 (preprojComp_of_good_R): if all summands Rⱼ(y) of all radicals are good, all indecomposable projectives are good, and the good modules form a preprojective component.
